about.metaDescription: Notai is built solo in Romania, for ADHD and creative minds. Local-first, EU-hosted, no AI training on your notes — ever.
about.title: A calm place to think, built by one person.
about.intro: I built Notai because every notes app I tried was either too rigid (Notion), too noisy (Obsidian plugin soup), or too lossy (Apple Notes). I wanted something that respects ADHD brains: forgives interruptions, lets ideas land in any shape, and never punishes you for not having a system.
about.whatIsBody: A local-first notebook with sticky windows, drawings, real-time sync, and a small amount of AI for when you need it. Web, Windows, macOS, and a browser clipper today; mobile and Linux next.

whatItIsNot.notion: Not a Notion clone. No databases, no relations, no formula language.
whatItIsNot.wiki: Not a wiki. Hierarchy and tags exist, but they are optional.
whatItIsNot.ai: Not an AI-first product. AI helps; it never gets in the way.
whatItIsNot.surveillance: Not surveillance-ware. No analytics inside your notes, no AI training.

about.whereBody1Suffix: (Belgium). PostgreSQL for metadata, encrypted Cloud Storage for attachments. Realtime collaboration runs on a dedicated Hocuspocus server. We never train AI models on your notes, never sell or share your data, and never embed analytics inside notes you write.
about.whereBody2Prefix: You can export everything as Markdown at any time, and you can fully delete your account from inside the app. See the
about.whyBody: Calm, respectful software is rare. I want Notai to feel like a friend that quietly keeps your thoughts in order, not another tool that demands you adapt to its system. The rules are simple: capture must be instant, the editor must never lock you in, and your data must always be yours.
about.operatorBodyPrefix: Notai is operated by Vlăduțescu Dragoș Cătălin, persoană fizică, Romania.
about.ctaText: Free forever for personal use. No credit card. Works offline.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Subscribe to a calendar via its public iCal/webcal URL. Events from the next 7 days will show on your dashboard. Read-only — Notai never writes back to the calendar source.
calendars.helpSummary: Where do I find the iCal URL?
calendars.helpGoogleBody: : Settings → your calendar → "Secret address in iCal format". Treat the URL as a password.
calendars.helpOutlookBody: : Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → ICS link.
calendars.helpAppleBody: : Right-click a calendar → Share → Public Calendar → copy URL (replace {webcal} with {https}).

db.title: Databases
db.description: Every property key you use becomes a tiny database. Open one to see all notes that share that property in a sortable table.
db.empty: No properties yet. Open any note and add one from the Properties panel below the editor.

emailIn.title: Email-to-note
emailIn.description: Forward or compose an email to your secret address; the subject becomes the note title and the body becomes the note. Only mail from your account email address is accepted.
emailIn.notConfigured: Inbound email isn't configured on this deployment yet ({var} not set). Your address is shown for preview but mail to it won't arrive.
emailIn.helpBullet1: The {token} in your address routes mail to your account. Treat it like a password — anyone who knows it can create notes in your account.
emailIn.helpBullet2: Mail must come from your account email; spoofed senders are rejected.
emailIn.helpBullet3: HTML emails are converted to plain text. Attachments are not yet stored.
